WITH
CTE AS
(
    SELECT FORACID, ENTITY_CRE_FLG, ACCT_OPN_DATE, BNK_CODE, SOURCE_CODE, ISLATEST, ISACTIVE, SCHM_CODE, SCHM_TYPE, DEL_FLG, INSERT_DTTM
    FROM  ( SELECT 
			FORACID, ENTITY_CRE_FLG, ACCT_OPN_DATE, BNK_CODE, SOURCE_CODE, ISLATEST, ISACTIVE, SCHM_CODE, SCHM_TYPE, DEL_FLG
			, FILE_NAME
			, 0 WorkFlowI
			, 0 TaskRunId
			, CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime) Insert_Dttm
			, ROW_NUMBER () OVER(PARTITION BY FORACID,BANK_ID ORDER BY LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME ,12),8) DESC) RN
			FROM BUSC.DEP_GENERALACCOUNTMASTER A
			WHERE A.ENTITY_CRE_FLG = 'Y' AND A.SCHM_CODE NOT LIKE '09%' AND LEFT(RIGHT(A.FILE_NAME,12),8) <= '20240122' ) BDG
    WHERE RN = 1 and FORACID NOT IN (SELECT ACCOUNTID FROM DW.DIMACCOUNT WHERE SOURCESYSTEMCODE = 'DEP' AND CURRENTINDICATOR = 1))

SELECT COUNT(1) cnt FROM CTE A
INNER JOIN  DW.RefDepositVerifiedAccounts B
ON B.FORACID = A.FORACID AND CAST(CONVERT(CHAR(8),B.ACCT_OPN_DATE,112) AS INT) = CAST(CONVERT(CHAR(8),A.ACCT_OPN_DATE,112) AS INT)
INNER JOIN (SELECT CustomerAccountID FROM BNKM.CustomerAccount WHERE SourceSystemCode = 'DEP') CA on CA.CustomerAccountId = A.FORACID
